_readme: Where the beat library lives. The Beat Machine reads this first, so
moving the folder again only means editing the path below.
Owner decision 2026-07-18: off iCloud, onto the TBOTC 3 drive next to
the sample packs (that drive already has to be connected to make a
beat at all, since the one-shots live on it).
If this path is unreachable the machine falls back to searching the
usual spots and warns instead of silently starting an empty library.
